**Job Description

**Do you want to define the evaluation methodology and technical requirements that underpin effective AI evaluation and monitoring within the business at one of the leading financial institutions in the Nordics?

Join Danske Bank's newly established AI Model Assessment team in Business Controls & Product Management. As AI Evaluation Methodology & Platform Requirements Lead, you will hold a 1st Line of Defence role with clear ownership of the technical methodologies used to evaluate AI models and AI-enabled solutions, and of the technical requirements for the platforms that support their evaluation and ongoing monitoring. You will translate business-owned risk and control needs into clear methods, metrics, data, evidence, traceability and platform capabilities that can be implemented consistently across the Bank's technology landscape.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a consistent, scalable and evidence-based capability through which the business identifies, evaluates, monitors and manages AI model risk.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark, Vilnius, Lithuania, Warsaw, Poland, Stockholm, Sweden or Helsinki, Finland.

**What You Will Be Doing

**The AI Model Assessment team is a business-owned control capability that performs evidence-based assessments of AI models and AI-enabled solutions across the Bank. We work with business owners, developers, engineers and platform teams to understand how solutions operate, define the evidence required for assessment, and establish the evaluation and monitoring capabilities needed to identify, assess and manage model risk where it arises.

Our mission is to enable responsible innovation by providing the business with a consistent and scalable framework for evaluating AI systems, monitoring their performance and risk, and demonstrating that appropriate controls are operating effectively.

As AI Evaluation Methodology & Platform Requirements Lead, you will own the evaluation methodology and define the technical requirements for the platforms, tooling and data capabilities used by the 1st Line of Defence to evaluate and monitor AI models and AI-enabled solutions. Your mandate is to ensure that the business has robust, implementable and auditable means to assess its AI risks and controls. Your focus will be on specifying what the evaluation and monitoring capability must deliver rather than owning software development or platform operations.

You will work closely with the independent 2nd Line AI model risk function, which sets the overarching risk framework and provides oversight and constructive challenge. You will translate that framework into practical evaluation methodologies, technical requirements and business-owned controls, provide transparent evidence of how requirements are implemented, and support the resolution of identified gaps.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• Owning, developing and maintaining the methodology for evaluating AI models and AI-enabled solutions, including evaluation objectives, test approaches, acceptance criteria and evidence standards.

• Defining the functional and technical requirements for evaluation and monitoring platforms that enable risk management, including data ingestion, test execution, metric calculation, observability, evidence capture, reporting, access controls and auditability.

• Translating model risk, business and assessment requirements into reusable evaluation methods, representative datasets, metrics, thresholds, monitoring indicators and structured evidence requirements.

• Determining how AI system architectures, components, dependencies and data flows affect evaluation scope, test design, monitoring coverage and the technical capabilities required from supporting platforms.

• Defining platform-agnostic requirements that support evaluation and monitoring across environments such as AWS Bedrock and AgentCore, Databricks, Azure OpenAI and embedded third-party AI platforms.

• Setting requirements for reproducibility and end-to-end traceability across models, prompts, datasets, configurations, system components, evaluation results, monitoring signals and changes over time.

• Prioritising opportunities to standardise and automate evaluation and monitoring activities, and working with evaluators, platform owners and engineers to convert approved control requirements into practical platform capabilities.

• Engaging with the Second Line model risk function to interpret applicable requirements, demonstrate how they are operationalised, respond to constructive challenge, and ensure that evaluation and monitoring evidence supports effective independent oversight.

**About You

**An experienced AI evaluation, model risk, data, architecture or platform professional who can establish rigorous evaluation methodologies and turn business risk and control needs into clear, implementable technical requirements for enterprise platforms and tooling.

You have:

• Proven experience designing or governing AI/ML evaluation methodologies, including test objectives, datasets, metrics, thresholds, acceptance criteria and evidence standards.

• Experience translating evaluation, monitoring, risk and control needs into functional and technical requirements for platforms, tooling, data pipelines and reporting capabilities.

• Experience with AI/ML evaluation, business-owned model risk management and controls, technical assurance, MLOps, LLMOps, AI platforms or AI observability.

• Familiarity with cloud AI services or enterprise AI platforms; experience with AWS Bedrock or AgentCore, Databricks or Mosaic AI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable platforms is an advantage.

• Strong understanding of evaluation and monitoring principles, including representative datasets, experiment configuration, metric design, regression testing, monitoring indicators, traceability and evidence capture.

• Ability to distinguish methodology and requirements ownership from platform implementation, while collaborating effectively with engineers and platform owners. Python or similar tools for analysis, prototyping or investigation are an advantage, but software development is not the primary focus of the role.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate evaluation, monitoring, risk and control requirements across business, assessment, platform, engineering, architecture, data and risk functions.

Experience with AI evaluation or observability technologies, for example Phoenix or comparable tools, is an advantage but is not a prerequisite.

**What We Offer You

**You will join the newly established AI Model Assessment team in Business Controls & Product Management, helping build the Bank's consistent and scalable business-owned capability for AI evaluation, monitoring and model risk management.

The team combines technical AI evaluation expertise with model risk management and works across the Bank's AI initiatives. In this role, you will connect evaluators with platform, engineering, architecture and data teams by defining the methods and technical requirements their solutions must support, ensuring that risk ownership and control evidence remain anchored in the business.

If hired in Lithuania, your monthly salary would range from 4320 EUR to 6480 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be AI Science

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If you are passionate about defining robust AI evaluation methodologies and the technical requirements for scalable evaluation and monitoring platforms that support effective business ownership of AI risk, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Khaled Alizai, Head of AI Model Assessment at khali@danskebank.dk. We are screening the applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply.

Join us and help build the business-owned foundation for effective AI model evaluation, monitoring and risk management at Danske Bank.

Uni-Tankers

AI Lead

Shape the technical future of AI at Uni-Tankers

At Uni-Tankers, we see AI as an opportunity to work smarter, make better decisions, and create greater value across the business. We are looking for an AI Solutions Architect/Engineer who can turn business needs and enterprise data into secure, reliable, and practical AI solutions.

As our first AI specialist, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape how AI is designed, developed, and applied across Uni-Tankers. You will be hands-on in building agents, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions. This role is for someone who enjoys building the solutions that empower the organization in a meaningful way.

Reporting to Thomas Thomsen, CFO, you will play a key role in connecting business needs, data, and technology. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, including our Business Intelligence Controller, to make effective use of enterprise data and take AI solutions from early ideas into secure and maintainable production use.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Understanding business needs and translating them into AI solutions

• Designing, building, testing, and deploying AI agents and applications

• Collaborating with stakeholders, partners, and consultants while retaining technical ownership

• Embedding security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI into solutions from day one

• Contributing to the AI roadmap by prioritizing opportunities based on impact and feasibility

Are you the one to build our AI foundation?

We are looking for someone who combines technical capabilities with curiosity, ownership, and business understanding.

You may have a background in software engineering, data engineering, cloud architecture, machine learning engineering, applied AI, solution architecture, or a related field. Your exact background is less important than your ability to design, build, and deliver AI solutions that work reliably in practice.

You are comfortable moving between architecture and implementation. You can discuss a business challenge with a non-technical colleague, translate it into a technical solution, and then contribute directly to building and operating that solution.

You likely:

• Experience delivering AI, data, or software solutions from concept to production

• Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Foundry, including security, governance, and compliance

• Solid understanding of data engineering, ETL processes, data lakes, APIs, and systems integration

• Ability to make sound technical decisions balancing security, reliability, performance, maintainability, user experience, and cost

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business recommendations

• Experience in business process optimization and identifying opportunities for improvement

• A proactive and curious mindset, combining technical skills with the ability to understand business needs across functions

Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, or similar technologies would be an advantage.  More importantly, you have a demonstrated ability to deliver real-world AI, data, or software solutions, regardless of platform or academic background.

Not checking every box?

You do not need to meet every requirement to do well in this role. AI technologies continue to develop rapidly, and we value people who can learn, adapt, and apply solid technical principles across different platforms.

If the opportunity excites you and you believe you can make a meaningful contribution, we welcome your application.

What you can look forward to

At Uni-Tankers, people make the difference. You will join a collaborative culture built on trust, ownership, and teamwork.

In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to help establish our technical AI foundation and shape how AI is applied across the organization. You will work closely with colleagues across functions and locations, turning business needs, technology, and data into practical solutions that create value for both the business and the people behind it.

You will have room to shape technical decisions, development practices, architecture, and future priorities while remaining close to hands-on delivery.

In return, we offer:

• An international environment with knowledgeable and dedicated colleagues

• A high degree of influence and ownership in a strategically important area

• The opportunity to build and implement solutions rather than only advise on them

• Close collaboration with colleagues working with data, technology, operations, and business development

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health insurance, and lunch arrangement

• Social activities and events throughout the year

• Modern office facilities at our headquarters in Middelfart.

Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Service Solutions Anti-Corrosion – Marine, Energy & Infrastructure

At Hempel, we trust you to shine. If you have the drive to contribute and embrace new challenges, you’ll enjoy great opportunities with us.

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Service Solutions – Corrosion to strengthen and grow Hempel’s global service portfolio across Marine and Energy & Infrastructure. In this role, you will turn customer needs and market opportunities into scalable service solutions that create value across industries including Marine, Renewables, Oil & Gas, Rail, and Construction.

You will be part of our Service Development team, working closely with colleagues across Hempel to shape the future of our service offering.

**What will your key responsibilities be?

**

• Own and develop the service portfolio for corrosion and asset integrity, including value propositions, service content, pricing, and performance targets

• Translate customer needs and market trends into new service opportunities, developing a clear roadmap that supports Hempel’s commercial and sustainability ambitions

• Lead cross-functional development and implementation of new services, working closely with R&D, Service Operations, Sales, Marketing, technical specialists, and external partners

• Turn technical expertise into customer value, identifying challenges related to corrosion, coatings, inspection, and asset integrity and translating them into practical, scalable solutions

• Manage the service portfolio throughout its lifecycle, continuously evaluating and improving services to ensure they remain relevant, competitive, commercially viable, and scalable

**Do you have the expertise to create customer value?

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Chemistry, or a related field

• Experience in product management, service development, or commercial roles, ideally within Marine, Energy & Infrastructure, or other heavy industries where involve corrosion as frequent challenge

• Working knowledge of corrosion, protective coatings, and asset integrity

• Understanding of inspection, condition assessment, and how asset data can support maintenance and asset-management decisions

• Strong analytical, strategic, and project management skills, with the ability to turn insights into action

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and commercial functions

• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach, with a passion for developing solutions that create measurable value

**Driving the future of Hempel Services

**Our Service Development team is part of Hempel Services and is responsible for developing services that complement Hempel’s coating solutions. We work across Marine and Energy & Infrastructure to understand customer challenges, identify new opportunities, and develop services that improve asset performance, extend asset life, and create additional customer value.

You will join a team of 7 passionate and experienced colleagues and have the opportunity to shape a growing global service portfolio in a collaborative and international environment.

**Does this sound like a match?

**Please submit your application letter and CV in English via our recruitment system by clicking ‘Apply for position’ at the top right of the page.

Final deadline for applications: Oct 21, 2026

For further information about the job, please contact Therese Marie Østergaard Sjølin via tsjoe@hempel.com

Application due

2026-10-21

Seniority Level

Mid-Senior level

Job Functions

Business Development

Industry

Chemicals

_At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

_At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

**Flat Roof Windows is one of VELUX's strongest growth opportunities. We are looking for a Product Manager who can help unlock its full potential.

**In this role, you will combine strategy, product management, and commercial leadership to identify where future growth will come from and how we turn opportunities into business results.

**Your Responsibilities

**Based at our headquarter in Hørsholm, you will join the global Flat Roof Windows Category Management team, a highly engaged team of five professionals, - including you.

Reporting to the Head of Flat Roof Windows, Category Management, you will contribute to the product roadmap process by providing insights, analyses, and recommendations that support both future product development and the optimization of existing products, helping to unlock new growth opportunities and improve market performance.

Working across Product Development, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, Strategy and regional organizations, - you will drive business development initiatives that strengthen strategic and commercial growth, competitiveness, and profitability.

Key responsibilities include:

• Working closely with Product Development to define requirements, evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and influence the future direction of our product portfolio throughout the product lifecycle.

• Identify and drive strategic and commercial growth initiatives across the category including driving business development activities, KPI tracking, and performance follow-up in close collaboration with regional markets.

• Leading pricing activities through market analysis and commercial insights to strengthen competitiveness and profitability.

• Building robust business cases and recommendations that support data-driven decision-making and organizational alignment.

• Monitoring market trends, customer behaviour, competitive activity, regulations, and category performance to identify opportunities and risks.

The role includes some travel within Denmark and internationally, to engage with customers, markets, and colleagues across the organization.

**Your Profile

**There is no single path to success in this role. While your experience is important, your mindset, curiosity, and ability to create impact are equally valued.

You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and understand that great ideas only create value when successfully implemented. You naturally build relationships, challenge constructively, and bring stakeholders together around a common goal.

Most importantly, you are motivated by creating meaningful business results while working collaboratively in a dynamic international environment.

We imagine that you:

• Have at relevant degree combined with at least 5 years of product management experience in a global organization, preferably within a technical or manufacturing industry.

• Possess strong commercial acumen and understand how product, pricing, and portfolio decisions drive business performance.

• Have experience working with structured product development frameworks and stage-gate processes, preferably within technical product environments.

• Demonstrate strong analytical skills and sound judgment to transform market insights, customer understanding, and data into compelling business cases that drive strategic and commercial decisions

• Demonstrate strong team player and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence decisions, and drive collaboration across a complex matrix organization.

• Communicate confidently and effectively in English, adapting your communication to different audiences.

In addition, you are energized by working in a fast-paced environment and contribute positively to team culture, even during periods of high activity.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to influence decisions that matter.

You will join a team with a central role in shaping the future of one of the VELUX Group's most important growth categories. The position offers significant exposure across the organization and a chance to influence business-critical decisions with direct commercial impact.

This is not a traditional product management role focused solely on maintaining an existing portfolio. It is an opportunity to identify where future growth will come from, define the strategic choices required, and help mobilize the organization to realize that potential.

You will work alongside experienced and passionate colleagues in a collaborative environment characterized by openness, trust, knowledge-sharing, and high ambitions.

As a values-driven company, the VELUX Group is guided by commitment, courage, mutual respect, and teamwork. We offer significant responsibility, strong development opportunities, and the chance to contribute to creating better living environments around the world.

**Application and Contact

**To learn more about the VELUX Group and life at VELUX, please visit VELUX Careers.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Applications and interviews will be reviewed and conducted on an ongoing basis.

Join us and help shape the future of Flat Roof Windows.

Our operations team is looking for a Property Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will partner closely with our software engineers to shape the future of our platform. You’ll have the opportunity to span the entire process, from managing complex portfolios and advising landlords to deciding which manual tasks our engineers should automate next.

Do you spend your entire day in UNIK or EG Bolig on stuff and wonder if it could be automated and taken care of by robots? We want to change that. Right now is the best time to join because you’ll get the chance to shape your own role and help us enter new markets across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by 90s software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and legal notices to strip human error and bureaucracy out of the rental experience. By removing the friction, we allow landlords and tenants to actually communicate, putting the human connection back at the centre of the business.

Proper is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property operator. We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with software engineers and product designers to shape our product with your domain expertise.

• Own the portfolio: Manage the daily administration, including lease contracts, rent adjustments, compliance, and maintenance.

• Bridge the gap: Identify the friction points in your daily work and help the product team decide on what to build next.

• Be the expert: Act as the primary advisor for landlords on the complex side of property: legislation, strategy, and finance.

• Operate at scale: Pilot our automated systems to manage a portfolio size that would be impossible at a traditional firm.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have a minimum of 2 years experience in property management and actually enjoy solving the puzzles of the Danish Rental Act.

• Done with legacy tech: You’ve used the old systems and you know they suck. You probably already have ideas on how to fix them.

• A "product" thinker: You don’t just want to follow a checklist; you want to build a better system.

• Numbers don’t scare you: You’re comfortable with budgets, utility accounts, and tools like Visma e-conomic.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable assuming ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish for legal documents and English for our office culture.

**What You’ll Get

**Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen, two minutes from Kongens Nytorv.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

Do you want a broad accounting role with significant responsibility and excellent development opportunities?

If you are an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership, working independently, and being part of a collaborative team, this could be exactly the opportunity you have been looking for.

At Gubra, we are experiencing continued growth and development. As our business expands, so do the opportunities for our employees to develop professionally and take on increasing responsibility. We are therefore looking for a Financial Accountant to join our Finance team and contribute to maintaining a high level of quality, compliance, and operational excellence across our group companies.

In this role, you will become part of our finance function where teamwork, trust, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

A broad accounting role with responsibility across multiple areas

As Financial Accountant, you will be responsible for a variety of accounting and controlling activities spanning day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing activities, reporting support, and audit preparation.

You will have ownership of your own areas while working closely with your colleagues in Finance. We take pride in supporting one another and working together to ensure successful month-end closings, reporting deadlines, audits, and daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Managing accounts receivable, including invoicing, cash registrations, reminders, and communication with customers' finance departments

• Maintaining and managing the fixed asset register, including verification of physical assets and correct accounting treatment

• Handling lease accounting in accordance with IFRS 16

• Performing foreign currency revaluations on currency accounts

• Acting as system owner for Corpay, PLEO, and e-conomic

• Preparing statutory and regulatory reporting, including submissions to Statistics Denmark and other authorities

• Supporting colleagues with accounting- and finance-related questions

• Participating in month-end closing activities, reconciliations, and audit preparation

• Contributing to process improvements, internal controls, and finance-related projects

• Supporting ad hoc tasks across the group's legal entities

As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and actively influence how we develop our finance processes and controls.

An experienced accounting professional with a proactive mindset

Naturally, we are looking for someone with the right professional qualifications. However, your approach to work and collaboration is equally important.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through on commitments, and enjoys working in an environment that combines structured routines with changing priorities and deadlines.

In addition, you bring:

• You likely have 5+ years of experience from a finance function where you have worked independently with bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing, and financial controls.

• Strong Excel skills and experience with financial systems

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your areas

• A positive and collaborative mindset with a willingness to support colleagues across the organization

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

Experience from an international company with entities in multiple countries is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Likewise, experience with Corpay, PLEO, and/or e-conomic is beneficial but not essential.

We are particularly interested in someone who is curious and analytical. You notice when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and work proactively to find a solution rather than simply reporting the deviation.

Your new team

You will join a Finance team consisting of four colleagues, including yourself. We work closely together, share knowledge, and support one another in delivering high-quality financial operations.

The role can be structured as either a full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week), depending on your preferences and qualifications.

We look forward to welcoming a colleague who enjoys being part of a team while maintaining ownership of their own responsibilities.

What we offer

• A broad and independent role in a collaborative Finance team

• A full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week)

• Real responsibility and ownership from day one

• The opportunity to influence processes, workflows, and internal controls

• Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility of working from home

• Ongoing opportunities to develop your role and responsibilities

• An informal and positive working environment

• Dedicated colleagues and a strong team spirit

• Competitive salary based on qualifications

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Start date as soon as possible, although we are happy to wait for the right candidate

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

Are you a skilled Refrigeration Technician passionate about securing high-quality technical support?

Advansor is looking for an Aftersales Engineer to join an international team driven by climate action and delivering the best customer support. We design and produce the world’s best sustainable CO2 climate solutions. We know CO2 by heart, having gained rock-solid experience from designing and producing more than 14,000 racks. We proudly share our expertise, best practices, and training with our customers through webinars, online training, and 2-day courses at our state-of-the-art training centre.

Your role

Working from our facilities in Brabrand, you will become part of our Aftersales Team. We handle support, warranty, training, and commissioning support of our sustainable CO2 refrigeration and heating systems. Technical Support is one of our core businesses, and your main responsibility will be securing high-quality support for our customers.

We support customers across Europe and LATAM, and the team is represented both at our HQ in Brabrand and locally in these regions.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Providing technical support via phone and email, guiding customers through optimization, fault diagnosis, and daily operations.

• Participating in our 24/7 support setup to ensure our customers always have a technical lifeline.

• Handling warranty claims efficiently and professionally.

• Collaborating across the organization to solve complex issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.

• Traveling approximately 25 days per year as part of our international support setup.

Your background

• You have a background as a Refrigeration Technician or hold similar experience.

• Knowledge about CO2 as a refrigerant is an advantage, but we will make sure you receive the proper training.

• You are quality-conscious, solution-oriented, and driven by a desire to share your knowledge with other technicians.

• You communicate clearly and professionally in English (our corporate language), both verbally and in writing. Additional language skills are an advantage.

We offer

As part of Team Advansor, you will get to work with more than 350 competent colleagues of more than 35 different nationalities and join us in our mission: to design and produce the world’s best sustainable climate solutions. You will become part of a highly ambitious company that values a good working environment, diversity, and teamwork.

Salary is decided based on your qualifications.

Please contact Martin Toft, Technical Support Manager, Aftersales at mto@advansor.com or by phone: +45 51 27 54 96 if you have any questions about the position or Advansor as a workplace.

Sustainable CO2 climate solutions

As a market-leading manufacturer, we have designed and produced more than 14,000 CO2 systems for sustainable commercial and industrial cooling and heating around the world since 2006.

Many people associate CO2 with global warming. We’re cool with that. Literally. Because CO2 is the most climate-friendly refrigerant: It is non-toxic, non-flammable and does not affect the ozone layer or harm our drinking water. That is why we are ’cool with CO2’.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Product Creation Learning Partner – Maternity Cover (Minimum 12 Months)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building change management and learning capabilities and fostering a learning culture at scale? Do you thrive when working with tools and processes, and are you naturally curious about finding new ways to use them? If so, you could be our Senior Product Creation Learning Partner during a maternity cover of at least 12 months.

At 3Shape, Product Creation is our term for R&D. It represents the organization responsible for developing and improving our products across hardware, software, engineering, and related product-development disciplines.

We are looking for an experienced learning partner to join us on a fixed-term maternity cover. In this role, you will build and embed a scalable capability framework that ensures Product Creation teams are equipped to work effectively across processes, tools, and ways of working.

During the maternity-cover period, you will use your stakeholder-engagement skills and your ability to align and influence across organizational levels and functions. You will combine these strengths with solid experience in building and maintaining training frameworks and structures that fit the organization’s needs.

You will be part of the Product Creation Excellence (PCE) team, which consists of around 10 people, all based in Denmark. Together, we enable Product Creation and adjacent functions across processes, training, tools, strategy, and transformation.

Core Responsibilities

Training framework & architecture

• Define the learning and capability framework and structures that support tool and process adoption, ways of working, and competence building: Standardize how training is designed, deployed, and maintained (including anchoring structures, super-user and ambassador methodologies, communities of practice, learning journeys, etc.).

• Continuously improve and expand the learning and capability framework and plan for Product Creation in collaboration with the Product Creation team.

• Develop and anchor training: Enable and support the organization to own and deliver training locally where appropriate, while ensuring central support and training structures are available where needed.

Capability mapping and training roll-out

• Continuously map and prioritize training needs with stakeholders based on business needs, maturity across technical functions, necessity, and criticality.

• Define and drive rollout plans in collaboration with functional owners and/or the PCE team.

• Establish regular cadences for training areas and structures, ensuring an appropriate frequency of training events, reviews of training materials, trainer setup and coaching, and cycles for communities of practice and other learning environments.

Integration with business & transformation

• Ensure alignment with transformation initiatives and operating model changes.

• Support change management and the adoption of new practices.

Capability tracking & improvement

• Define and follow up on KPIs for capability building (e.g., adoption, proficiency, and coverage).

• Drive feedback loops and the continuous improvement of the training setup.

• Maintain an overview of capability gaps and critical skill needs.

This role may involve some travel.

Ideal profile:

For this role, we believe a good fit is someone who can bring:

• Experience in building learning frameworks in complex medical regulated R&D or technology organizations (including experience with different training and learning models, e.g., train-the-trainer, communities of practice, coaching, and online training).

• A collaborative, team-oriented mindset. We depend on strong teamwork within the PCE team and across other teams and functions, so it is essential that you thrive when working with others to solve challenges and realize opportunities.

• An understanding of and/or interest in how different profiles learn, with the ability to balance technical tool training with soft skills such as leadership.

• Experience with change management and the large-scale rollout and/or adoption of new processes, preferably in a large R&D or other technical environment.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build bridges between technical and non-technical functions.

• The ability to drive adoption without formal authority.

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

At 3Shape, you will join an international R&D environment in central Copenhagen, working closely with advanced hardware, software, and engineering teams that develop products to improve dental care globally. You will have the opportunity to shape learning and capability-building practices and see your work make a direct difference for colleagues.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international place to work. But most of all, we are a diverse group of over 50 different nationalities who all contribute to a thriving company culture. We partake in social clubs, monthly social activities, and various in-team activities as well. If that’s not enough, then add on:

• Central Copenhagen location.

• A globally recognized technology company.

• An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• Breakfast every day and a delicious, healthy lunch prepared by our private chefs.

• A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Join us for a maternity cover of at least 12 months and be part of a team improving treatment and care in a meaningful industry. We encourage all qualified professionals who are passionate about building strong learning capabilities in a complex product-development environment to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis; however, we plan to conduct interviews in October and November.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

jobs.occupation: Analyst, Corporate & Sustainability Advisory DK & NO, Large Corporates & Institutions – Denmark
jobs.description:
**Job Description

And are you ready to take a key role in advising some of the largest and most complex corporates in Denmark on capital structure, funding strategy and sustainability? This entry-level role offers rapid learning and broad exposure to complex advisory work.

Experience from banking, consulting, treasury, or client-facing roles would be beneficial for your success in this position.

**What We Offer You

Our supportive learning environment focuses on continuous feedback, and you will be part of a pan-Nordic network of professionals with strong opportunities for development within strategic corporate advisory and sustainable finance.

**Are you ready for the next step?

For more information, please contact Head of Corporate & Sustainability Advisory DK/NO Anders Johannessen at ajohan@danskebank.dk or Chief Analyst Hanne Brendstrup at habre@danskebank.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Step into a role where you can help redefine how infrastructure is delivered across a global enterprise. With strong Azure expertise, a passion for automation and Infrastructure as Code, and curiosity about the opportunities AI brings to engineering, you could be our next Engineer, Cloud Platform Lead.

Meet your future team

You will join our Infrastructure & Cloud team and become part of a transformation that is shaping the future of IT at VELUX. Our mission is to modernise and simplify how infrastructure services are delivered across the organisation, moving towards a platform-driven approach built on automation, Infrastructure as Code, cloud technologies and AI.

Working closely with Infrastructure specialists, Security teams, application teams and strategic partners, you will help establish the foundations that enable innovation across VELUX. While parts of our operational delivery are provided together with our strategic partner HCL, the focus of this role is on designing what comes next. You will help define new ways of working, strengthen our platform capabilities, increase automation and drive the transformation of infrastructure services across VELUX.

Based in either Kolding or Hørsholm, you will join a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, experimentation and continuous improvement are encouraged. Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to influence how technology is delivered across VELUX for years to come.

What We Offer

This is more than a cloud engineering role. It is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of infrastructure services at VELUX.

Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, Infrastructure as Code and automation are key building blocks in our journey. At the same time, we are actively exploring how AI can support engineering, operations and service delivery, helping teams work smarter and focus on higher-value activities.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Evolve our Microsoft Azure platform, architecture and cloud governance

• Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines

• Build reusable patterns, self-service capabilities and standardised solutions that simplify infrastructure delivery across teams

• Explore and implement opportunities where AI can support engineering, troubleshooting, documentation and operations

• Support FinOps initiatives and improve cloud cost transparency and optimisation

• Expand and mature Azure Arc across our hybrid infrastructure environment

• Collaborate closely with Infrastructure specialists, Security teams, application teams and external service providers

• Provide technical leadership and help translate architectural ideas into scalable, reliable solutions

• Help shape the future infrastructure operating model at VELUX, driving standardisation, simplification and automation across the organisation

• Partner with our strategic operations provider, HCL, to continuously improve service delivery while strengthening internal platform and engineering capabilities

What You Will Bring

You are passionate about cloud technologies and enjoy turning complex challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You combine technical depth with a collaborative mindset and thrive in environments where technology and ways of working are continuously evolving.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

• Bring experience with cloud architecture, governance, networking, security and monitoring

• Have worked with Infrastructure as Code and Git-based delivery workflows, preferably using Terraform

• Have experience with Azure Arc or a strong interest in hybrid cloud management

• Possess a strong automation mindset and a desire to reduce manual effort through modern engineering practices

• Are curious about AI and how it can be applied to cloud engineering and IT operations

• Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Have experience working with suppliers, managed service providers or outsourced operations

It will be an advantage if you also have experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kubernetes, Windows Server or other hybrid infrastructure technologies.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**Client Management

**As part of the production of our digital marketing products, we are looking for a Client Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you support our clients throughout their website journey, from the first conversation to publication, and help them get the most out of their new digital presence quickly and smoothly.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• You will contact our Dutch- and English-speaking customers across the world (no sales) via welcome calls for our website and digital marketing products.

• You will discuss the clients' requirements for their website, consult on structure, and ensure all expectations are clearly defined, keeping the bigger picture of their business goals in mind.

• You will handle domain and email account transfers on behalf of clients.

• You increasingly work alongside AI-supported tools that simplify parts of the process, giving you more time to focus on the client rather than paperwork.

• With your positive, consultative and service-oriented approach, you contribute daily to delivering an outstanding client experience.

**Your profile

**

• You have professional experience in client service and enjoy daily client interaction.

• Your affinity for digital products and processes allows you to quickly familiarise yourself with new systems, including AI-supported tools and workflows.

• You have a basic understanding of website structure and design principles, and you can explain steps and results to clients in an understandable way.

• Experience with CRM systems is a plus.

• You have excellent written and spoken Dutch and English language skills.

**Why this role is different

**You are not just processing requests. You guide clients through one of the most visible moments in their business, the launch of their new website, and you see the direct result of your work go live. You work closely with an international team, and increasingly alongside AI supported tools that take over routine steps in the process. That gives you more room to focus on what actually matters, the client in front of you.

**About Us

**group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.

When you join group.one, you become a part of a global network that values collaboration, growth, and excellence. Join us in creating online success stories!

**We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

****We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here - what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

****We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

**Welcome to one.com, where innovation meets passion. We are a leading web hosting and domain registration company dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses online. Since 2002, we have been committed to delivering reliable, user-friendly, and affordable web services. Our mission is to make it easy for anyone to build and maintain an online presence, and we believe in integrity, innovation, and putting our customers first.

_Do you want to shape how Pandora leverages data, analytics, and AI to drive operational excellence globally? Are you passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights, building high-performing teams, and enabling better decision-making at scale? Then you could be the Manager, Global Operations Analytics & Insights we're looking for!

_As Manager, Global Operations Analytics & Insights, you will lead Pandora's Global Omni Operations analytics agenda, ensuring trusted data, meaningful insights, and consistent performance measurement across regions, channels, and functions. You will act as the business owner of Operations data and analytics, driving the strategy, governance, and capabilities required to support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Working closely with stakeholders across Global Omni Operations, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology, Finance, and other business functions, you will ensure that analytics, data, and AI-enabled investments are aligned with business priorities and deliver measurable value. **

• Drive alignment and adoption across Omni Operations functions, regions and stakeholders on performance measuremen, analytics priorities and data-driven ways of working

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for advanced analytics and AI-enabled decision making

• Build strong partners with Operations, D&A and D&T teams

• Lead and develop the Operations Analytics and Insights team

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring experience within analytics, performance management, operational excellence, or business intelligence, combined with a strong ability to translate business challenges into scalable data and insight solutions.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Experience leading analytics, performance management or operational excellence activities

• Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business performance measurement and data-driven decision-making

• Experience working across multiple operational functions in a global environment

• Experience influencing stakeholders and driving alignment across functions

• Understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities

**We Hope To See

**

• You have a strategic and analytical mindset

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills

• You are an effective communicator and decision-maker

• Collaborative and approachable leader with a continuous improvement mindset

• Curious, proactive and results-oriented

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global Operations Excellence organization, where you will be responsible for leading the Analytics & Insights agenda across our Global Omni Operations network. Working closely with stakeholders across Operations, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology, Finance, and regional teams, you will help shape the future of operational performance measurement, analytics capabilities, and AI-enabled decision-making.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence strategic priorities, build analytics capabilities at scale, and create tangible business impact across Pandora's global operations network.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4B

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. The result is a professional and dynamic space that delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through thousands of points of sale worldwide. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs approximately 39,000 people globally and is committed to sustainability, innovation, and creating meaningful experiences for customers around the world.

Do you see yourself supporting and monitoring group wide TECH development projects in Karnov from project business case preparation through financial accounting, transfer pricing compliance and audit? **About Us | Psychological Safety | "we walk the talk"
